title: Jonathan Blow - Jai Demo and Design Explanation (KEYNOTE) - Updated
summary: Jonathan Blow's LambdaConf 2025 keynote demonstrates the Jai programming language and explains its design. It includes demos of metaprogramming and tools that visualize programs.
why: HN points to it for seeing Jai's compile-time metaprogramming in practice and for Blow's tools that visualize programs to spot problems.

quote.text: he has said that he doesn't like Rust because he feels that satisfying the borrow-checker slows down iteration time
